remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing, Darien's premier luxury apartment community, where upscale living meets everyday convenience. Ideally situated across from the Metro-North train station, Heights Crossing provides easy access to New York City within a vibrant coastal setting. This newly constructed 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment is a seamless blend of modern finishes and functional living. The light-filled layout features wood-style luxury vinyl tile flooring throughout as well as a spacious kitchen with quartz countertops, an island, custom cabinetry, GE appliances, and designer backsplash. An in-unit stacked washer and dryer offer added convenience. The bedroom is complemented by a sleek, well-appointed bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower. Designed for peace and privacy, the building features soundproofing between floors and exterior foam insulation. Heights Crossing features a landscaped courtyard with a fountain and ground level retail. Located near the Noroton Heights shopping district with access to a grocery store and pharmacy, and just a short drive to Darien's beaches and Great Island. Amenities include secure building access, garage parking, elevator, on-site property management, fitness center, golf simulator, office spaces, and a fireside resident lounge with free WiFi. Trash and recycling chutes are located on each floor.
